reviews.text: Wouldn’t go anywhere else. Dr. Buchanan is absolutely the best (their whole team truly is). They are so thorough and patient with their animals patients (and their parents too!). My dog was so scared of our first vet but going to them he freaks out much less. They were great on ensuring I had everything for my dog to travel to Ireland. And they are always open to chatting about any wild questions I have (like how can I make my dog live forever lol).

I’ve trusted Dundas West Animal Hospital with my furry friends for 10+ years. They are always wonderful, kind, proactive, and explain everything in a way that leaves me feeling like I’ve made an informed decision!

Took my pup to DWAH recently and had the most pleasant experience. Right when we walked in, we were greeted warmly and assisted right away. The techs and Dr. Moon were so kind. They walked us through everything and took their time with my pup since he was anxious. Felt like our dog was in great hands, you can tell they love what they do.

i had three same-age cats who were patients here in their last years (14-17) and i can attest that elderly pets are not suitable for those without “disposable” income. diagnostics & treatment do not come cheap. that said, i have found the doctors, technicians and support staff here to have, for the most part, excellent “bedside manner.” i recently had to euthanize the last of my feline companions and i tried my best not to look back. about six weeks later, however, i looked at the cremation package and found a handwritten card from Dr Fuller that was so genuinely caring and sweet that it brought many tears. it was very clearly written by someone who loves cats. thanks for that, Dr Fuller. it meant a lot.
Very professional, warm and personable vet clinic staffed with caring, pet loving people. Always get a great welcome

Classic overpriced Toronto Animal Hospital looking to scam their clients, overcharge for basic medicine and have a forced mandatory basic consultation fee, not impressed with the vets either, apart from such fees being an obvious scam as I’m paying hundreds of dollars for you to run a stethoscope over my dog and tell me my dog’s OK, the vet was scared of dogs on top of it and had poor handling skills and lacked confidence overall with dogs, so why am I paying a fee for your expertise when you’re not even confident to handle what you’re a so-called expert on? Just another trained vet looking to pay their bills through your ignorance, do your research, or ignorance is bliss for you and your vet’s pockets! Went once and never again!
Staff is friendly and knowledgeable. They love what they do there and it shows. Was very happy as soon as I walked in the door. Highly recommend

This is by far one of the best veterinary clinics I've been to in the last 10 years. It's extremely clear that the staff care about animal welfare through their interactions, thoughtful overview of any diagnostic information and flexibility of appointment scheduling. Even if you don't live in the area, this place is worth travelling to, as you'll get the best quality of care from friendly and professional staff.

I really appreciate that they have a dedicated area for cats. Going to the vet is already so stressful so having little nooks and space away from our canine pals helps. The staff is also so caring and attentive. They will lay out all procedures and costs transparently so you can make the right decision.

Very unfortunate and disappointing experience.

Everything started off  well with this clinic, and I truly believed I had found the veterinary clinic where I could trust my puppy’s health and care for years to come.

Unfortunately, my experience changed when I actually needed their support and expected the same level of care, accountability, and commitment to putting my puppy’s health first.

To me, the true value of a veterinary clinic isn’t only seen when everything is going well !!!  it’s seen when a client genuinely needs help, communication, and support. Unfortunately, that is where I felt this clinic fell short.

It is extremely disappointing, especially because I initially had so much confidence and trust in them. I genuinely hoped this would be my puppy’s long-term veterinary clinic, but after this experience, that trust has been significantly affected.

I had a great experience at this vet. Dr. Krayz was so thorough and compassionate with both my cats  and helped me get through managing HCM with one of my boys. I really trusted this place and it’s the best vet I’ve been to yet. I appreciate all their help with everything and will miss this animal hospital as I move away.
Been an EXCEPTIONAL experience, I love taking my cat there.

A wonderful spot. I brought my old dog Yoki in last week and she was treated with compassion and care as always. Dr. Moon and the vet techs Katie and Fae were all amazing. No hard upsell, just facts about all available options and straight answers to all my questions. I was upset and they were very kind. Glad the old girl and I have their help and support as we finish out our journey together. Really thankful for everyone at Dundas West Animal Hospital. Can't recommend enough.
Great vet! Highly recommended.

When I needed insulin syringes for my cat they wouldn’t sell me any. My cat wasn’t a patient there so they refused. Other vets in the neighborhood just needed to see the prescription or get a call from my regular vet! They could have helped but they wouldn’t!
Great vets office. Very pleasant people.
Great veterinary doctor 👏 👌 excellent service and good staff for your all your pets 😀 needs. …

We had such a lovely visit while at the Dundas West Animal Hospital. Their team was so patient with us and had so much care for our Dog Ringo.  Our dog was anxious and they gave him and us plenty of time to adjust and try various approaches always putting our dogs best interest to heart.  Excellent service.

I was disappointed with my experience at Dundas West Animal Hospital.

My dog was prescribed medication, but the amount provided ran out a lot sooner than expected. I called multiple times and left messages, but no one returned my calls. When I finally got through, I was told they hadn't called me back because they didn't have the medication in stock. A simple update would have been appreciated.

Instead, I was offered a larger and more expensive bottle. The lack of communication was frustrating, especially when it involved medication my dog needed.

In general, I found the clinic expensive and often focused on upselling products and services. My biggest concern, however, was the poor communication and lack of follow-up.

Based on my experience, I would not recommend this clinic.

I want to thank Dr. Bahlmann and her team for their professionalism and care.  I had to make the decision to let my cat go because her health situation was not good on my first visit.  The way they took care of my kitty and me, then walked me to my car made all the difference.  Plus I love that they have a seperate cat area. THANK YOU DUNDAS WEST ANIMAL HOSPITAL!

They are truly the best clinic in Toronto. I have taken my cats to DWAH for many years, and even though I moved and now I have to drive 1 hour to get there, it is absolutely worth it! All the team is knowledgeable and kind, they genuinely care about your pet. My cats are rescued and some are not friendly. The team uses fear free techniques to make the appointments smooth and as a result my cats are not stressed at the vet. The vets are so good with their thorough exam, they don't underestimate any signs and give us all the options. I love that they have a cats only hospital, it makes all the difference! It's another level of medicine for those who want the best for their fur kids.
Best vet ever.

I have been bringing my dog to this veterinary clinic since he was 3 months old, but my most recent experience was disappointing.
I booked an appointment specifically for blood work after finding a tick on my dog. Before the appointment, I emailed to ask about the cost. I was initially quoted $360 for blood work, a checkup, and vaccines, despite clearly stating that I only wanted blood work done. I then received another quote of $174, followed by a third quote of $126. The inconsistent pricing was confusing and frustrating.
At the appointment, the veterinary technician made comments about my dog's chart, saying, "You should see what's on his chart," which felt unprofessional. My dog is anxious at the vet and can be protective of me, so I left the room to make the process easier. As I was leaving, I heard the technician repeatedly call my dog "Shark," which is not his name.
While waiting, I heard my dog let out a loud yelp, which was concerning. Afterward, the technician explained that she had to pull his arm to obtain the blood sample and that this was the reason for the yelp. When she returned with my dog, she appeared extremely frustrated because he would not stay still.
I understand that some dogs are difficult patients and that veterinary staff have challenging jobs. However, after being a client for years, I expected more professionalism, better communication, and a calmer approach when handling my dog. Unfortunately, this experience left me feeling uncomfortable and concerned which is leading me to not come back.

The Original owner has retired and sold to a corporate entity. Prices have skyrocketed as a result. I can no longer endorse this business and have changed my rating to 1 star. It's not prices that have skyrocketed, it's greed, liten to them trying to justify their actions. DO NOT GO HERE, SUPPORT A LOCAL, PRIVATELY OWNED VET CLINIC.

We love it here.
The staff and doctors are amazing.
Super upfront about the cost, and they don’t overcharge.
Our fur-baby had eye surgery, and everything went amazingly.
We also love the fact that the cat hospital area is specialized for them.
Have always received great care for our pets.
Great service and support. The vet took time to explain everything to be and took great care of my puppy. Even helped remove a tick for free one time. They really care.
Dr. Do was exceptional helping with an emergency medical situation that my cat went through.
Your 5 stars warms our hearts, Alex! We're thrilled you enjoyed your experience with us.
Your positive feedback motivates us, Owen! We look forward to seeing you again soon.

I have never felt inclined to write a review for a vet clinic, but the team at Dundas West is truly incredible. Every single member of their team we have had the pleasure of working with is amazing. In the past year we had our dog neutered and treated for a few ear infections. The neuter went amazing by Dr. Van and he checked in multiple times after to make sure he was recovering well! Every visit the team takes their time to ensure our pup is comfortable, and has a positive experience (he gets nervous, but they are patient with him). We love it here and thank you for making us and our lil guy feel comfortable at each visit! We are so thankful to have you as our vet team!!

We are sorry to hear your experience has left you feeling this way. We would appreciate your feedback on how we can improve your experience in the future. If you would like to discuss the matter further, please give us a call.

One of the best animal hospitals. It has a separate building only for cats and they offer acupuncture which is difficult to find in Toronto. The doctors and technicians are incredible people, professional and compassionate.

What a positive experience! My elderly cat Mimi went for her initial visit … and this was the first time in her 17 years of seeing many vets that she did not cry, pee, throw up or all three at once at the vet’s! Dr. Do and the team were fabulous, so gentle and caring. I cannot recommend enough.

I came here for a semi-emergency visit when our family vet was too far away. I called the clinic and they were able to get me an appointment within an hour, which I was incredibly grateful for. The staff were absolutely wonderful and treated my cat, Dobby, with such kindness and care. Even during a stressful situation, they made the experience a very positive one. You can truly tell that everyone here genuinely cares about their patients.

Recently moved to the area and decided to switch vet clinics since the previous one wasn’t the most reliable and the experience was always awful. What a difference it was at this location! From the front desk help to the vet assistant to the vet herself everything was seamless. They took a lot of time to talk to me about my dogs health and history and even informed me he didn’t need a lifestyle specific vaccine which the previous clinic had administered anyway for the last 8 years.
I usually have a lot of anxiety before the vet but I’m looking forward to my next visit with my frenchie!
Great experience, thank you!
We are new to the area, and love this hospital. The staff are extremely knowledgeable and kind, and we feel that we couldn’t be in better hands.

Hi Julian, we are sorry to hear your experience has left you feeling this way. We would appreciate your feedback on how we can improve your experience in the future. If you would like to discuss the matter further, please give us a call.
Dr Emily took care of our cat Ozzy and her is amazing and so sweet to the animals!!!
We appreciate you taking the time to leave a 5-star rating. Thank you for your support.
It's a really modern friendly, great veterinary hospital the staff was super caring about my animal. They get busy but that's a good thing. As it shows how good they are at what they do.

I can’t say enough good things about Dundas West Animal Hospital and especially Dr. Aaron Van.

Before coming here, I was at another clinic where my dog Penny was often bounced between different vet techs and vets. She had quite a few health challenges, and that lack of continuity was really hard. After just one visit to Dundas West, I knew this was different and fully transferred her care.

Dr. Van took care of Penny during the last two and most difficult years of her life. He was incredibly compassionate and always treated her like she was his own dog. I never felt rushed, and I could genuinely tell how much he cared about her well-being.

When Penny received her cancer diagnosis, Dr. Van was there for me every step of the way. He took the time to explain options, supported me through tough decisions, and made one of the hardest experiences of my life feel less lonely.

I will always be grateful that Penny got to spend her final years under the care of Dundas West and their amazing team. They gave her comfort, dignity, and love when it mattered most.

Thank you for everything. ❤️🐾

The staff here are very committed. When my cat was discharged they called me at night and followed up by email. They also took a lot of time to explain the diagnosis and treatments, and the fees, so I felt comfortable with my decision. They use a fear free approach (my last vet clinic was very rough) so now I don’t have to fight my cat into the carrier to get there. The cat only side is a big bonus on not stressing her too. I’ve been to six veterinary clinics over the years and this one is the best.

The staff are friendly and knowledgeable, and my experiences with the vets themselves were positive. That said, I found the pricing to be very high (nearly $900 for two rounds of puppy vaccinations and a few months of NexGard flea and tick medication.)

At first I assumed this was just reflective of the neighbourhood, but I later learned the clinic is owned by VetStrategy, a private equity firm. That helped explain the higher costs, as private equity ownership prioritizes returns to shareholders, and it’s something potential clients may want to be aware of when choosing a clinic.

They are the best!  The staff really cares and it shows and Dr. Moore is amazing.  Myles says hi!   :)  We moved to this clinic bc of Dr. Moore but found as a whole it is the best.  Thanks for all thr care you have given Myles you extended his life and most importantly his QUALITY of life by years.

This is the Mary Poppins standard of care.  It was our absolute pleasure to work with Dr. Krayz, Amy, Alice, Sarah, and Angus.  All which were exceptional, kind, and went above and beyond to change the course of Maka's concern.  I went in expecting a stressful experience and instead left feeling like we had the very best care, kindness and overall experience.  The Disney of vet clinics.  My stinky kid has maybe accepted treats in public on one occasion.  Dr. Krayz came in and camped out on the floor and persisted gently with building a bond.  It worked and she even had treats from Dr.Krayz!  Dr.Krayz takes the time to step out and do further research to ensure the very best level of care in her patients.  I was blown away.  My previous clinic left me feeling uncomfortable and like I hadn't received the best level of care.  This was a 15 out of 10.  Thank you to the team for the complimentary tissue and care with this helicopter mom.  May your pillow always be cold, your bus on time, and your streaming platform always have new episodes of your favourite show for you to watch.  Thank you again from the both of us.

!!!
My dog was a long-term patient at this clinic. After visiting another clinic once in September, I was shocked to be told that I now have to pay for yet another full vet exam just to return here — even though only three months have passed.

During this entire time, my dog continued getting vaccinations at this same clinic with a technician. The staff knows my dog’s history perfectly well. There is absolutely no medical justification for forcing another exam.

This policy feels blatantly money-driven, not care-driven. Requiring frequent, unnecessary check-ups just to keep a client “active” looks like a cash grab, not responsible veterinary practice.

I’m not willing to keep paying for redundant visits simply to satisfy an internal rule. Because of this, I won’t be coming back and would not recommend this clinic to others.
Thank you for the 5 stars, Kie. We're so glad we exceeded your expectations.
Good vet. Very modern

Dundas West Animal Hospital is one of the best veterinary hospitals in all of Toronto. Although it is not the cheapest, it is worth absolutely every single cent, and here is why:

They actually inspect your dog. The vet/techs take a decent amount of time reviewing past records, going over lifestyle, talking through many options and their results. It feels like they aren't kicking you out before you can get a word in.

They trust you. It never felt like me against them, despite the fact that it's not cheap and I am by no means "well off". They don't make you feel like a bad parent for not being able to do the greatest and latest. They are so flexible.

Referrals. When I could not afford a specific treatment option, they provided referrals to clinics that I could afford.

Final thing - I knew there was something up with my dogs heart (for a long time!) and her previous vet never suggested doing any sort of exam on her heart or lungs even though I had brought her in for breathing issues a couple of years before going to Dundas Animal Hospital. The first time I brought her in, Dr. Van validated everything I was thinking was wrong with her.

Maggie is happy again, I am aware of her issues and we are treating/already treated! If Maggie could write, she would be making this review herself hehe 🐾 thank you, from both of us!!!

Amazing staff!! The doctor took his time seeing my cat and explaining everything to me. I was very impressed by the speed in which they had the blood and urine samples results. I also love that they have a separate space for cats only. Would definitely recommend taking your pet there

Absolutely the best vet I have been to.  Ever.

I have taken my various pets to a few veterinary practices over the past (eep!) 50 years as I've lived in different neighbourhoods around Toronto.  Dundas West Animal Hospital is the absolute best.  Their staff work as a team, and their veterinary assistants and patient representatives are outstanding.  They understand you're entrusting them with a beloved family member.  They value your subjective information in diagnosis, and involve you in discussing treatment.  If there are ongoing concerns, they advise you of options and let you know what to watch for as your pet ages.  (And there's a separate entrance for their cat clinic!  No more stress-peeing in the carrier in the waiting room.)   I'm blessed to have found them.  Thanks, DWAH
Thank you for everything you’ve done Dr. Kay, Dr. Killburn and the whole DWAH team! Milly and I could not be more grateful 💞 your compassion, honesty and dedication shows in each and every visit! …

Dr. Kai Moore’s communication and commitment are exceptional, she has gone above and beyond for my cat. I received continuous updates, thoughtful explanations, and genuine support. Despite Luna’s rare and challenging stomach condition, Dr. Moore has worked relentlessly to build a plan tailored to her needs, always letting me know my options.

I’ve had my cat for 11 years and chose Dundas West  due to convenience after I moved to the area, and I’m thankful to have chosen it. The best vet Luna has ever been to!!! Thank you so much to Dr Moore for taking care of Luna in such a scary time for us both.
We appreciate you taking the time to leave a 5-star rating. Thank you for your support.
A bit pricey but at-most care and professionalism

Useless staff. I brought in a lost dog and the staff kept evading us, not scanning his microchip, vanishing next door and to the back, and lying. Dishonest and uncompassionate, I'm so glad we didn't take our pet here when looking at vets in the neighborhood. They do not care about the safety and wellbeing of animals.
Only went here once so far but our experience so far has been wonderful. Very caring. Very professional. Will be back again for sure.
A 5-star review is the highest praise. Thank you for your glowing recommendation!

Our recent experience at Dundas West Animal Hospital (DWAH) was so reassuring. Our cat was very ill which had us very worried. Dr. Liz and team were incredible. My anxiety level before our visit was 10/10 and after our visit it went down to 3/10. My cat does not like going to the vet, but I was surprised at how well he did at the Cat Only clinic - I'm so glad there's one available. Nicole at the front desk was friendly, helpful and very reassuring. I really appreciated the attention and care we received. I know we are in good hands at DWAH. Thanks for all you do!

Love this clinic and great staff, I have been to several and live 45 min away but it worth the drive knowing you get amazing care and knowledgeable doctors.  My niece Matilda used to work there and recommended  their care, knowledge.and expertise.  I have been there 1 1/2 years and very pleased!
Thanks for the fantastic rating, Lucy! We strive to make every visit a 5-star experience.
Very impressed with the entire practice - from the space to the support staff and most importantly the Vets!  Highly recommend !

I was there on Friday and Monday with my cat and they are amazing people I would like to thank Dr. Fuller who did everything to help my cat he was amazing doctor who was so kind to me and my mom when we put my cat down I recommend you take your pets  there because there are so good with your pet and very kind people.

I can not stress enough that this is the best place to bring your pet. I unfortunately have had both my dogs very ill in the last few months and one unfortunately pass away and in both instances I was taken care of to a level you could only pray for. The staff here is attentive caring and extremely compassionate they deal with people sometimes on their worst day and are able to provide a service I am amazed by because im sure its not easy. There is no other place in the city I would consider bringing my dog. From the front desk staff to the nurses and vet techs all the way to the Veterenarians everyone here is phenomenal. They are priced fairly and I have never felt gauged by any service they recommend. I honestly can not say enough good things! Thank you Dundas West Animal hospital for your incredible care of my babies.

Truly the best team! We became patients at Dundas West Animal Hospital 6 years ago when it was just our one cat. Even though we moved from the west to the east end, we continue to bring our furry babies, which have now become 2 cats and 1 dog.

The team is the best, hands down. Dr. Folosea and Dr. Bahlmann especially are extremely knowledgeable, attentive, and caring. Same goes for the technician and reception team.

I have recommended many of my friends to bring their own furry babies here and they are also big fans.

Thank you for everything you do, from Iris, Lucifer, and Freddie.
